name: Scarfin Torrent
introDiscord:
A torrent rushes through old bite scars carved into Leviathan bone.

Scarfin Barracudas use the channels like racing lanes.
introTwitch:
A torrent rushes through old bite scars carved into Leviathan bone.

Scarfin Barracudas use the channels like racing lanes.

scarfin-torrent-approach.prompt: Three routes cross the scarred rapids.

left.message: Star Candies rest beneath an ancient scale.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle says:

'Barracuda race attempt.

I lost.

Glimmer says walking into current did not qualify as racing.'

forward.message: A Scarfin Barracuda rockets through one bone scar.

left.message: A Barracuda overtakes you with insulting ease.

right.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's revised rules:

'RACE RULES:
1. I get head start.
2. Barracuda cannot be Barracuda.

Fair.'

forward.message: A navigator's chest rests behind a scarred rib.

scarfin-torrent-threshold.prompt: Bloodless Rapids churn around three bone-lined lanes.

left.message: A strongbox rests beneath the current.

right.message: A Scarfin Barracuda enters the final lane.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Training complete.

Career in professional Barracuda racing cancelled.'

bossPromptDiscord:
The rapids clear.

A single enormous scarred Barracuda enters the course.

Use /yes to enter Bloodless Rapids or /no to honor Shizuki's sensible
retirement decision.
bossPromptTwitch:
The rapids clear.

A single enormous scarred Barracuda enters the course.

Use !yes to enter Bloodless Rapids or !no to honor Shizuki's sensible
retirement decision.

boss.revealText:
A massive Barracuda tears through the rapids.

Rendwake Barracuda reveals itself!

completionText:
The Rendwake vanishes downstream.

Professional career avoided.
